extras.name: Ulele
extras.note: Riverside Native-Florida seafood hot spot; get the seafood risotto and grilled oysters; loud, long waits, inconsistent; skip the fried gator; $50–70/person

extras.name: Oxford Exchange
extras.note: Bookstore + glass-roof brunch, very photogenic; daytime only; mixed food reviews, slow service; reservations required; $30–45/person

extras.name: Badfins Food + Brew
extras.note: Clearwater Beach tacos + seafood; pineapple-cup cocktail; +4% card fee; $35–50/person

extras.name: Aji Limo (Peruvian)
extras.note: Asian-palate friendly; grilled octopus, lomo saltado; seafood rice divisive, salty; weekday lunch $17.99; $50–60/person

extras.name: Jubao Palace (inside Hard Rock casino)
extras.note: Best: BBQ trio and oxtail rice noodles; fried rice/noodles bland; open to 4 am; possible age limit; $30–45/person

extras.name: La Teresita
extras.note: Cuban home cooking since 1972, big and cheap; on the way to Clearwater

extras.name: Weeki Wachee Mermaids
extras.note: Underwater show since 1947, only in Florida; 13:30 / 15:00

extras.name: Crystal River Manatees
extras.note: Manatee season from November; the only place in the US to legally swim with them

extras.name: Vizcaya Museum & Gardens
extras.note: Italianate mansion + bayfront gardens; $25/person; closed Tuesdays

extras.name: Key Biscayne Lighthouse
extras.note: Quiet, clearer water than South Beach

extras.name: Fort Lauderdale · Las Olas
extras.note: Easy stop on the way to Miami

budget.total: ~$6,000–8,000 for 4 ($1,500–2,000 each), excl. flights and shopping
save: Skip Lightning Lane: save $120–150 (but long Thanksgiving lines)

todo: One person buys 4 in the Disney app, shares via Family & Friends; everyone enables MagicMobile
Opens 3 days before for off-site guests; one person buys for all 4
Register every driver; ask about toll-pass fees or bring SunPass
people: Food lead / co-driver · lands 11/23 22:59, flies to JFK 11/30 06:15
Finance & supplies / 11/29 day lead · lands TPA 11/23 00:27
tips: Sunset ~17:30, fully dark by 18:00: outdoor plans in daylight
No backtracking; no single walk over 1.5 km
One room with 2 Queen Beds each night (not 2 Doubles)
Cuban portions are big and salty: 3 mains for 4 people
Deep-discount resale tickets are often fraud; Disney tickets are name-locked, highest risk
Disney tickets are non-transferable (fingerprint at first entry); buy only from Disney or authorized sellers
Jasik waits ~5.5 h at TPA: eat in SLC, bring neck pillow, eye mask, power bank; terminal Marriott is an option

team.intro: We run this trip like an 8-day project: each person owns one area and has the final say there; when things conflict, protect the time-critical milestones.

roles.name: Toby
roles.title: Project lead / lead driver
owns: Master schedule and all bookings (tickets, tours, Bern's, hotels)
Daily departure time and final calls
do: Post today's departure time + first stop each morning
Before each stop: arrival time, whose phone has the tickets, latest leave time
Buy Lightning Lane for all 4 on the morning of 11/23
On 11/27, make the last Saturn V bus (14:30)
roles.learn: Leading a team: delegating and letting others own their part

roles.name: Rosemary
roles.title: Food lead / co-driver
owns: Where we eat and what we order
Swap driving with Toby on long legs
do: Confirm next day's meals the night before (lines, reservations, hours)
Ordering rule: 3 mains for 4, Cuban portions are big
Swap driving on 11/27 to Miami and 11/29 to Tampa
roles.learn: Reading foreign menus, judging restaurants from reviews, ordering for a group

roles.name: Kevin
roles.title: Navigation & parking / Miami leg lead
owns: Co-pilot navigation: call turns one intersection early
Parking: find it in advance, pay via ParkMobile, remember where
Miami leg 11/27 evening – 11/29 morning (he booked the hotel)
do: Handle meals Monday before Rosemary arrives
Lead the two Miami days so Toby can rest
Leave Miami before 08:00 on 11/29; US-41 in daylight only
roles.learn: Route planning, parking and detours in an unfamiliar city

roles.name: Jasik
roles.title: Finance & supplies / 11/29 day lead
owns: Bookkeeping: every expense into the ledger
do: Whoever pays tells him on the spot; he logs it (payer, amount, split)
Read the checklist before leaving: phone, power bank, wallet/ID, Disney app, water and snacks
Post tomorrow's wake-up, departure and packing list each night
11/29: wake-up call, departure reminders, pick lunch in Naples
roles.learn: Budgeting, planning and retros, and leading the team for a day

rules: Whoever owns it decides: give input, the owner makes the call
When in conflict, protect milestones (ticket slots, ferry, sunset, finishing the swamp road before dark)
One task at a time: what and by when; have them repeat it back
Nightly 5-minute stand-up: one thing that went well, one to watch tomorrow
Don't drive tired; everyone keeps their own phone, wallet and ID
Final-day retro: one thing learned and one thing to change
